_comment: Reference settings demonstrating the PostToolUse Prettier auto-format hook from issue #218. Copy hooks block into your local .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json to enable. Requires bash + jq + npx in PATH. The hook only runs Prettier on file types Prettier supports.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'FILE=$(printf "%s" "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.jsonc|*.md|*.css|*.yml|*.yaml) npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac'
